cards.text: Jeremiah is a prophet, and he's been carrying the LORD's hard warning to Judah: they broke His covenant (Jeremiah 11:10). Now Jeremiah talks to the LORD about something personal. The LORD informed him, so he knew, and showed him what certain people had been doing.

cards.question: Before the LORD showed him, what does Jeremiah say he was like?

answers.text: A gentle lamb led to slaughter

cards.text: Turns out people had plotted against him, like a surprise party that is NOT a party: 'Let us destroy the tree with its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be remembered no more.'

cards.question: Before the LORD showed him, Jeremiah knew about the plot against him.

cards.text: So Jeremiah turns to the LORD of Hosts, who judges righteously and examines the heart and mind. Friend, if somebody plotted against ME, I'd be hiding behind the ovens with my apron over my face.

cards.question: Jeremiah tells the LORD he'll get back at the plotters himself.
Jeremiah has committed his cause to the LORD. He asks the LORD of Hosts to let him see His ___ upon them.

cards.text: Then the LORD names who is seeking Jeremiah's life: the people of Anathoth. And Jeremiah's own roots are in Anathoth (Jeremiah 1:1).

cards.question: What do the people of Anathoth tell Jeremiah he must not do?

answers.text: Prophesy in the name of the LORD

cards.text: And if he keeps it up, they say, 'you will die by our hand.' Your hometown is supposed to hang your picture on the wall. Not plan your FUNERAL.

cards.question: The LORD of Hosts has heard the threat. What does He say He will do to the people of Anathoth?

cards.text: Their young men will die by the sword, the LORD says, and their sons and daughters by famine. He will bring disaster on the people of Anathoth in the year of their punishment.

cards.question: The LORD says a remnant of the people of Anathoth will be left.

cards.text: Jeremiah keeps talking to the LORD: 'Righteous are You, O LORD, when I plead before You.' Then comes 'Yet,' and I know that move, friend. I tell my oven it's doing GREAT right before I ask why my cookies came out like hockey pucks.

cards.question: Jeremiah wants to contend with the LORD about His judgments. He asks why the way of the ___ prospers.

cards.text: Jeremiah says the LORD planted the wicked, and they've taken root, grown and produced fruit. Tree talk again, and this time the wicked are the ones bearing fruit.

cards.question: Jeremiah says the wicked never talk about the LORD.
The LORD is always on the lips of the wicked. What does Jeremiah say about their hearts?

cards.text: Then Jeremiah says, 'But You know me, O LORD; You see me and test my heart toward You.'

cards.question: Jeremiah knows the LORD has tested his heart. What does he ask the LORD to do with the wicked?

answers.text: Drag them away like sheep to slaughter
Give them one more year to change
Send them off to a far country

cards.text: Earlier, Jeremiah was like a gentle lamb led to slaughter. Now he wants the wicked dragged off like sheep, and he asks how long the land will mourn and the grass of every field be withered.

cards.question: Jeremiah says the animals and birds have been swept away because of the evil of the land's residents.

cards.text: The people have been saying, 'He cannot see what our end will be.' Then the LORD answers Jeremiah: 'If you have raced with men on foot and they have worn you out, how can you compete with horses?'

cards.question: What is the LORD telling Jeremiah with the picture of the race?

answers.text: The wicked will soon slow down
He should stop running from trouble

cards.text: Then the LORD asks, 'If you stumble in a peaceful land, how will you do in the thickets of the Jordan?' Friend, I'm a stamper on a gold base, so put me in a race with horses and they'll be home ASLEEP before I clear the first hill.

cards.question: The LORD tells Jeremiah the betrayal reaches even his own ___.
The LORD tells Jeremiah to trust his father's household when they speak well of him.

findings.problem: "Turns out people had plotted against him" tells the baker that Jeremiah found out about the plot only afterward. That gives away card 4, which asks whether Jeremiah knew about the plot before the LORD showed him. Card 4 has not been answered yet, so card 3 is not building on an earlier answer.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

findings.problem: This story card has three sentences: "And if he keeps it up, they say, 'you will die by our hand.'" / "Your hometown is supposed to hang your picture on the wall." / "Not plan your FUNERAL." Only the opening card can go past 2 sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: This story card has three sentences: the quote of 12:1, "Then comes 'Yet,' and I know that move, friend.", and the oven joke. It is not the opening card of the walkthrough, so it is limited to 2 sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: "Tree talk again" says that Jeremiah 12:2 talks about a tree. It does not. 12:2 says the wicked were planted, took root, grew and produced fruit, but it never mentions a tree. Only 11:19 does. The card should name what the text actually uses, such as planting and fruit.

rule.text: Noticing. What he points out must be true.
